intro: These lines come from the Cherokee Phoenix (1828–1834), printed in Sequoyah's syllabary. Two machine readings disagree on one word of each line: the Library of Congress's OCR, and a reader we trained on this paper's own type. Your answers show which reading matches the print, so we can measure whether the new reader is better. The small pictures under a highlighted letter show how this paper printed it.
name: Cherokee: disputed lines

notes.Ꮎ: at the start of a word this paper prints a G-shaped letter (the first two pictures); inside a word it looks like θ (the last)
notes.Ꮩ: this paper prints it as Λ, an A with no crossbar

title: Cherokee Phoenix
